Seat Binding is now a clickable link to docs/platform/seat-binding/spec.md, which exists at 6d275ad81.

The new holder still states a false implementation fact: scripts/fgos-shell-integration.sh does NOT run `git rev-parse --git-common-dir`. It walks up from the physical cwd to the first dot-git entry and reads gitdir/commondir from disk with no git child (fgos-shell-integration.sh:27-29,57-90, since 10416a6b0). Only the test uses rev-parse, as an oracle (test/scripts/fgos-shell-integration.test.mjs:159). The workspace.rs half (GitDriver::open_at, workspace.rs:29) is now correct.

The <a id> anchors for 0011/0012/0013 make all 6 inbound fragments resolve: architecture-map.md x4 and cli-io-contract.md x2 (own link checker: 6 broken before, 0 after). Line 30 is now an in-page anchor that resolves. The clickable Related Files section is restored, and no ADR heading line changed.

The duplicate is gone (13 duplicate units now have 1 holder each), but the link is still dead and is now the only copy: the kept paragraph links ../../host-invocation-routing/legacy-cli-transition.md, which resolves to docs/platform/host-invocation-routing/legacy-cli-transition.md, a file that does not exist. This is the only new broken link in docs/platform after the commit; the before and after lists differ by exactly this one link.

Row 7 says it names every registered check, but it omits the 8 Git checks registered in a loop at src/setup/registrations.mjs:6354-6366: git-worktree-recovery, git-component-compatible, git-transport-config, git-trust-topology, git-operation-journal, git-native-locks, git-publication-refspecs and git-durability-capability. Code registers 143 checks; only the 135 with a literal id are listed. Row 7b equals code exactly (32/32). Removing model-policy-tier-coverage and adding the 8 checks the review named are correct. The receipt and verification.json claims ("135 checks", "registration sets equal code") are wrong for the same reason.
All 9 duplicated units (runtime-identity 267-342 vs activation-binding 488-566) now have one holder. The activation-binding links to the §11/§14 anchors, which exist.

spec.md now points to setup-doctor-registry.md#setup (the anchor is unique, line 186), and no copy remains. The <stateRoot>/terminal side effect was added; the registerFix terminal-dir backs it (registrations.mjs:4497).

The correction checks out: bindingHashEncoding occurs 10 times at f534aeaea~1, f534aeaea and cffe725b9 (none of them top-level), and 6 times at ae9b9a6ef/6d275ad81, which have a top-level key. The old receipt is untouched because it is outside the writable scope.

The rows now hold current corrections (rigorToTier removed, seat-binding-config) that are neither the legacy bytes nor the live table. Fenced row 1 differs from live h-02842f76ffd2 row 1, so there are now two divergent Data Dictionary holders. The verbatim current legacy row 1/1b (RUL102 cell forms, tierFallback family keys, RUL103 maxTier ceiling) is held nowhere. The pointers carrier in the same file (line 175) was correctly updated to the legacy bytes, so the two carriers are handled inconsistently. Fix: keep the carrier verbatim at current legacy bytes, or relabel it as adapted and bind it to the live table.

Reran late-areas/scan-legacy-drift.mjs read-only in /tmp/fgos-work/w3-d1b-resync, changing only the import path, root and destination. The result at HEAD 6d275ad81 matches the committed legacy-drift.json (head 7be0cbc52) for all 33 records, apart from the head field. The four files have missingCurrent=0 and missingChangedSinceInventory=0: work-state 327 units, runner 517, distribution 43, runtime-identity 170.

Recomputed in Node over every row, no sampling. Every sourceUnitDigest and sourceContent equals the HEAD legacy unit. Every targetUnitDigest equals the HEAD target unit, and ancestry is consistent (headings include themselves, blocks list their parents). Of the 968 content-present rows, 876 are exact and 92 are equal after removing only link targets, heading marks and whitespace. Both envelope rows have their content inside the bound unit. No source unit appears twice. The 2 target collisions are the legacy duplicate ADR 0002 heading and the two retired tee clauses.

Since inventory pin f0c76c5e5, 726 lines of at least 25 chars were added to the four legacy files. 709 appear verbatim (after normalization) in their successor files. Each of the other 17 is covered by an s13 heading-translation or adjudication row, checked one by one.
